# FreeGaming.ca

## About
FreeGaming.ca is Canada's free online games portal for English-speaking Canadians.
Hundreds of HTML5 browser games playable instantly — no download, no signup required.

## Categories
Puzzle, Racing, Sports, Shooting, Card Games, Strategy, Arcade, Adventure,
Multiplayer, Thinking Games, Action, Casual, IO Games

## URL
https://www.freegaming.ca

## Language
en-CA (Canadian English)

## Target Audience
English-speaking Canadians, all ages, all provinces

## Key Facts
- Free to play, forever
- No download or account required
- Works on desktop, tablet, and mobile
- Updated daily with new games
- Based in Canada (.ca domain)
